name: daimcentre.github.io
description: DAIM Open Research Portal — Centre of Excellence for Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Modelling, University of Hull

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');['dist','.astro','node_modules/.astro'].forEach(p=>fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}));console.log('Cleared dist/, .astro/ and node_modules/.astro.');console.log('If `astro dev` is running, RESTART IT — its content store was just deleted,');console.log('and it will serve empty collections until you do.');"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
